title: State of Bombay v. Kathi Kalu Oghad

content.caseIdentity: State of Bombay v. Kathi Kalu Oghad, AIR 1961 SC 1808
content.holding: 11-judge Bench held that "to be a witness" under Article 20(3) means imparting personal testimonial knowledge; taking fingerprints, handwriting specimens, or physical measurements does not violate Article 20(3).
content.relevance: Locus classicus establishing distinction between physical and testimonial evidence.
